authorityCeiling: The MLE owns model-workload envelope evidence, not generalized fleet reliability.
authorityRoute: Route any approval, consequence, control, or shared-system decision to the named external owner.
decision: Measure representative demand, latency, error, capacity, staged exposure, bake/abort rules, and degraded mode for the workload.
